div.head: II As 6.3
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe ðeof wræcan wille ⁊ nænne man gewundige, gesylle ðæm cyng CXX scill. for þon æhlype.
⁊ se þe ðeof wrecan wille ⁊ nanne mon ne gewundige, gesylle þam cyninge CXX scll' (to wite) for ðan æhlype.
And se ðe þeof wrecan wille ⁊ nænne man gewundige, geselle þam cyning CXX scill' for ðan æhlepe.
Et qui furi uindex presumpserit esse et tamen neminem plagiet (lęserit), emendet regi CXX sol. for ðam ehlipe (pro ipsa conclamatione).
⁊ se þe ðeof wrecan wille ⁊ nanne mon ne gewundige, gesylle þam cyninge CXX scll' to wite for ðan æhlype.
And he who seeks to avenge a thief, but does not wound anyone, shall pay a fine of 120 shillings to the king for [making such an] assault.
And he who wishes to avenge a thief, and yet does not wound anyone, is to pay 120 shillings to the king for the assault.
Und wer einen [hingerichteten] Dieb rächen will, jedoch niemanden [dabei wirklich] verwundet, zahle dem König 120 Schill. (zur Strafe H) für den Überfall.
And whoever wishes to avenge a [executed] thief and yet wounds no one [in doing so], let him pay the king 120 shillings (as a fine, H) for the assault.
